description: This file defines the 'Ods' class, a reader for OpenDocument Spreadsheet (.ods) files within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for checking file compatibility, listing worksheet names and info, and loading spreadsheets into PhpSpreadsheet objects, with internal logic for parsing XML structures and handling spreadsheet content.

classes.name: Ods
classes.description: A class responsible for reading and processing OpenDocument Spreadsheet (.ods) files within PhpSpreadsheet. It provides methods to verify file compatibility, extract worksheet information, and load spreadsheet content while handling the specifics of the ODS XML structure.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the provided filename is an ODS file by inspecting its zip archive contents and mimetype.

methods.name: listWorksheetNames
methods.description: Returns a list of worksheet names present in the specified ODS file without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed information (name, last column, total rows/columns) of each worksheet inside the ODS file.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Creates and returns a Spreadsheet object by loading the specified ODS file.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads data from an ODS file into an existing Spreadsheet object, parsing XML and handling styles, content, and settings.

methods.name: processSettings
methods.description: Extracts and applies worksheet-specific settings like active sheet and selected cells from the settings.xml in the ODS archive.

methods.name: lookForActiveSheet
methods.description: Locates and sets the active worksheet based on configuration data.

methods.name: lookForSelectedCells
methods.description: Identifies and sets the selected cells in worksheets based on configuration data.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selected cell(s) in a given worksheet based on provided column and row indices.

methods.name: scanElementForText
methods.description: Recursively extracts text content from a DOMNode, handling whitespace and text formatting.

methods.name: getMultiplier
methods.description: Determines the number of spaces to replicate based on a DOM attribute, used for text spacing.

methods.name: parseRichText
methods.description: Creates a RichText object from a string value.

methods.name: processMergedCells
methods.description: Handles cell merge operations based on XML attributes, merging cell ranges in the spreadsheet.
